title: avenula pruinosa
intro: Avenula pruinosa, commonly known as downy oat-grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Avenula pruinosa include its ability to act as a sedative and anxiolytic, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
